skill_name: Write a story about a young girl who gets lost in the forest.
workflow: Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Sophia who lived on the edge of a great forest. One day, she ventured deep into the trees on a mission to explore the unknown, but after hours of wandering, she became lost in the darkness of the forest. Suddenly, she realized that she had accidentally gone too far from her home. She panicked and started crying when, suddenly, a bright light shined in the darkness.
